title: Make each Create a Space theme preview look like its real theme

source.ref: Owner request 2026-11-13: CyberWitch is the complete preview, the others read as recolors; the address bar should read businessname.frequencylocal.com.

detail: Eight themes get their own preview blocks (fonts, photo hero or split hero, button shapes, offer cards, and a Spotlight phone in the theme's own layout), read from the shipped theme CSS and rendered theme pages. Services keeps its New World stand-in pictures (a probe pins them; its own squeegee hero is a one-line swap once the owner OKs the probe edit). Wildheart wears its own portrait. The address bar slugifies the Business Name live. Spotlight phones for Bold and Wildheart are a best guess: their design systems carry no Spotlight layout.
